app.tagline: Advertising reach forecasting for marketing and MLOps teams

dashboard.heroDescription: Configure your campaign inputs and calculate predicted unique reach using the live inference model.
dashboard.overviewDescription: Quick health and metadata summary for operators. Use System status for full detail.

panel.title: Campaign prediction
panel.description: Enter CPM, forecast window, audience size, and optional targeting to generate impression probabilities and estimated unique reach.

form.cardDescription: All fields map directly to the prediction API. Forecast duration starts at hour 0 automatically.
form.cpmHelper: CPM is what you pay per 1,000 ad impressions. Higher CPM generally improves auction competitiveness.
form.forecastHelper: How long the campaign is expected to run, in hours from the start of the window.
form.audienceHelper: Total audience size used as the reach denominator for unique reach estimation.
form.publishersHelper: Select one or more publishers when the catalog is available from backend metadata.
form.publishersUnavailableDescription: Publisher metadata is not available. The request will be sent without publisher filtering.
form.userIdsHelper: Comma-separated integer user IDs for technical or testing scenarios. Leave empty for broad audience targeting.

validation.audience_integer: Audience size must be a whole number.
validation.audience_min: Audience size must be at least 1.
validation.audience_vs_users: Audience size must be greater than or equal to the number of user IDs.
validation.user_ids_invalid: User IDs must be comma-separated integers.
validation.publishers_invalid: One or more selected publishers are not in the catalog.

results.summaryDescription: Estimated unique reach based on your audience size and the model output.
results.uniqueReachFormula: Calculated as audience size × probability of at least one impression.

breakdown.title: What these probabilities mean
breakdown.atLeastOne: At least 1 impression — the chance a typical user in your audience sees your ad at least once during the forecast window.
breakdown.atLeastTwo: At least 2 impressions — the chance a user receives two or more impressions (frequency).
breakdown.atLeastThree: At least 3 impressions — the chance a user receives three or more impressions (higher frequency).

alerts.formModelNotReady: The prediction model is not ready. Calculation may fail until required artifacts are available.
alerts.modelNotReadyDescription: The backend reports the model is not ready. Results may fail until artifacts are loaded.
alerts.metadataUnavailableDescription: Service metadata could not be loaded. Form defaults and alerts may be limited.
alerts.publisherEmptyDescription: Publisher metadata is empty. Requests will be sent without publisher filtering.
alerts.sessionSilenceDescription: The model applies a {{hours}}-hour session silence window when scoring engagement timing.
alerts.driftDescription: This campaign configuration may be outside the model's typical training distribution. Interpret results with extra care.
alerts.cpmGuaranteedWinDescription: Your CPM is above the maximum competitor CPM from metadata, which often indicates a likely guaranteed auction win.
alerts.cpmEdgeCaseDescription: Your CPM is approximately equal to the maximum competitor CPM. Auction outcomes may be uncertain (~50% win scenarios).
alerts.cpmLowDescription: Your CPM is below the median competitor CPM. Reach may be limited unless you increase bid competitiveness.
alerts.cpmThresholdsUnavailableDescription: Competitor CPM thresholds are not available from backend metadata.

unavailable.title: Prediction service unavailable
unavailable.description: Prediction service is unavailable because model artifacts are missing or not loaded.

sweep.panelDescription: Explore how predicted reach and impression probabilities change across a CPM range using your current campaign settings.
sweep.campaignInvalidHint: Complete valid campaign inputs on the left before running a sweep.

controls.stepHelper: Each sweep point increases CPM by this step. Maximum {{maxPoints}} points per request.

validation.sweep_max_below_min: Maximum CPM must be greater than or equal to minimum CPM.
validation.sweep_step_invalid: CPM step must be greater than zero.
validation.sweep_too_many_points: This range produces too many points. Reduce the range or increase the step (maximum {{maxPoints}} points).

chart.title: Sweep results
chart.emptyDescription: Configure a CPM range and run a sweep to visualize predicted reach and probabilities.

thresholds.unavailableNotice: Competitor CPM thresholds are not available from backend metadata.
thresholds.medianDescription: Typical winning bid level among competitors in training data.
thresholds.maxDescription: Upper competitor bid level; bids above this often win auctions more consistently.

unavailable.title: CPM sweep unavailable
unavailable.description: CPM sweep is unavailable because the prediction model artifacts are missing or not loaded.

errors.genericDescription: The sweep request could not be completed.

auction.panelDescription: Actionable insights from your selected CPM, competitor thresholds, and sweep results.
auction.noInsights: No auction alerts for the current configuration. Adjust CPM or run a sweep for more context.
auction.guaranteedWinDescription: Your CPM is above the maximum competitor CPM from metadata, which often indicates a likely guaranteed auction win.
auction.edgeCaseDescription: Your CPM is approximately equal to the maximum competitor CPM. Auction outcomes may be uncertain (~50% win scenarios).
auction.lowCompetitivenessDescription: Your CPM is below the median competitor CPM. Reach may be limited unless you increase bid competitiveness.
auction.thresholdsLimitedDescription: Competitor CPM statistics are not available from backend metadata. Win-rate guidance is unavailable until thresholds are provided.
auction.driftDescription: One or more sweep points are flagged for distribution drift. Interpret reach curves with extra care.
auction.sessionBurnoutDescription: Ads already seen by a user in the same session may not be shown again until the {{hours}}-hour silence window expires. This can reduce final reach for long campaigns.

history.title: Prediction history
history.description: Review recent campaign predictions stored by the inference API. Filter, inspect details, and export results for reporting.
history.noFilterResults: No records match the current filters. Adjust filters or clear them to see more results.

empty.title: No prediction history yet
empty.description: No prediction history yet. Run a campaign prediction on the dashboard to create the first record.

details.title: Prediction details
details.reachExplanation: Estimated unique reach from audience size and at-least-one impression probability.

systemAnalytics.recentActivityDescription: Aggregated metrics from stored prediction history.

system.title: System status
system.description: Detailed backend health, artifact checks, and service metadata for operations teams.

modelReadiness.notReadyDescription: The prediction model is not available yet because required artifacts are missing or not loaded. Reach forecasts will be unavailable until all artifacts are present and the model is loaded.
modelReadiness.loadedButNotReady: The model file may be present, but supporting data artifacts are still missing.
modelReadiness.publisherEmptyDescription: Publisher metadata is not available. The prediction form will be limited until backend artifacts are available.
modelReadiness.readyDescription: All required artifacts are present and the backend reports the model as ready for predictions.

states.errorDescription: We could not reach the backend. Check that the API is running and that VITE_API_BASE_URL is correct.
states.emptyDescription: The backend responded without usable data for this section.
